title.narrative: Justice for Roma in Ukraine

description.narrative: This project aims to combat discrimination against Roma who live in Ukraine. The project foresees that legal professionals will work together with Romani communities to increase Roma's understanding and capacity to use their legal rights. The impact will be that Roma will know their rights and feel confident to use the legal system should they be prevented from enjoying those rights. The project also aims at increasing Roma's trust in legal institutions, and confidence in lawyers and judges.
